item.title: Top 5 Steps to Resolve Context Issues in Blazor Components
item.description:
When migrating or developing Blazor components, especially between versions like .NET 7 to .NET 8, context-related issues often arise. These problems can prevent components from rendering correctly, leading to errors and unrecognized components in your IDE. This guide walks you through five crucial steps to resolve these context issues effectively.

Step 1: Verify Component Setup and Imports

Start by ensuring that your Blazor component is correctly set up and that all necessary namespaces are imported. The component might not be recognized if the appropriate usings are missing in the Imports.razor file.

item.title: Top 6 Steps to Resolve Azure Active Directory Authentication Issues in .NET 8 Blazor Applications
item.description:
When integrating Azure Active Directory (AD) authentication into your .NET 8 Blazor applications, you might encounter various issues that prevent successful user login or API access. These issues often stem from misconfigurations in the app registration or incorrect API permissions. This guide outlines six essential steps to troubleshoot and resolve these problems, ensuring smooth authentication and secure access to your application.

Step 1: Configure Azure AD App Registration Correctly

Start by ensuring that your Azure AD app registration is correctly configured. This involves setting up your app in the Azure portal and ensuring that Tenant ID, Client ID, and other critical details are accurate in your appsettings.json.
